goal: Stop test_run_waits_for_a_tick_holding_the_lock from failing at random. It turned agent-kit #97's validate red with a JSONDecodeError that had nothing to do with that PR.
changed: The stub gh in tests/test_local_ci.py holds an flock across each call's read-modify-write of its state file, and swaps the file in with os.replace, so a concurrent reader or a second stub call never sees it half written or loses an update.
A new test, StubStateTest, runs eight stub loops in parallel while reading the file.

claims.claim: The race is the cause: concurrent stub calls and a polling reader see a truncated state file, and the fix removes it.
claims.check: StubStateTest run 10 times against the old stub (10 failed: stubs crashed on a torn file) and 20 times against the fixed one (0 failed); test_run_waits_for_a_tick_holding_the_lock 20 times after the fix (0 failed); the whole test_local_ci.py module passes
claims.remaining: Measured on this Mac only. The CI runner, where the flake showed up, is checked by this PR's own validate run.

release.none: Test-only fix; nothing a user of the kit sees changes.
